'''Endstate Matrix: Adversity Vanguard''' is the second challenge cycle of [[Endstate Matrix]] spanning over [[Version]]s [[3.5]], [[3.6]], [[3.7]] and [[3.8]]. 

==Event Details==
Endstate Matrix progresses through Challenge Cycles. Each Challenge Cycle spans across multiple Challenge Phases, which reset with version updates. Rewards are offered independently for Challenge Cycles and Challenge Phases. 

※ The second Endstate Matrix Challenge Cycle "Adversity Vanguard" lasts from Version 3.5 to Version 3.8. 

===Duration===
* 2026-07-17 04:00 (server time) - TBA
** First phase: 2026-07-17 04:00 (server time) - 2026-08-19 20:59
** Second phase: 3.6 - before Version 3.7 update maintenance
** Third phase: 3.7 - before Version 3.8 update maintenance
** Fourth phase: 3.8 

===Requirements===
* Achieve at least 24 Crests in one phase of the [[Tower of Adversity]] and reach at least 3,500 points in one phase of the [[Whimpering Wastes#Respawning Waters: Torrents|Respawning Waters: Torrents]] in [[Whimpering Wastes]] after [[Version 3.2]]. 

===Rules===
* In Endstate Matrix, your skills will be tested through intense combats. Confront the enemies and earn points to claim corresponding rewards.
* Endstate Matrix consists of two Zones: Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion. Earn the required points in Stability Accords to unlock Singularity Expansion.
** Stability Accords: A maximum of three teams can be deployed. Complete the challenge by defeating all enemies in a single round.
** Singularity Expansion: The number of deployable teams is unlimited. After defeating all enemies in a round, stronger enemies will appear for the next team to tackle.
* During Adversity Vanguard, complete the Cycle Tasks and Challenge Tasks to earn Encrypted Data and unlock exclusive rewards. Encrypted Data will be cleared at the end of the Cycle.
** Adversity Vanguard consists of 3 Cycle Tasks. Cycle Tasks reset at the start of a new Challenge Phase. During Adversity Vanguard, up to 600 Encrypted Data can be obtained through Cycle Tasks.
** Adversity Vanguard consists of 3 Cycle Tasks. Cycle Tasks reset at the start of a new Challenge Phase. During Adversity Vanguard, up to 600 Encrypted Data can be obtained through Cycle Tasks.
** 4 Challenge Tasks are available in Phase 1. Starting from Phase 2, 3 Challenge Tasks will be available in each Challenge Phase. Challenge Tasks last for the duration of Adversity Vanguard.
* In Endstate Matrix, you must deploy three Resonators in each team and select a Power Circuit before starting the challenge. Endstate Matrix consists of two Zones: Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion. Earn the required points in Stability Accords to unlock Singularity Expansion (Singularity Expansion unlocks after defeating all enemies in Stability Accords). In Stability Accords, you may deploy up to 3 teams. Defeat all enemies in one round to complete the challenge. In Singularity Expansion, there is no limit to the number of teams you can deploy. Defeating all enemies in a round will unlock the next round, with enemies growing stronger each time.
** Each time a Resonator participates in a challenge, 1 point of Vigor is consumed. Resonators with 0 Vigor cannot be deployed. Vigor is calculated separately for Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion.
** In this gameplay, the same Weapon and Echo cannot be used by two different Resonators. If a Resonator equips a Weapon or Echo already used by a Resonator with a challenge record, the challenge cannot be started.

'''Lament Recon: Tacet Crisis''' is an [[In-Game Event]] in [[Version 3.5]]. 

==Event Details==
===Duration===
* 2026-07-11 10:00 - 2026-08-19 11:59 (server time) 

===Requirement===
* Reach [[Union Level]] 14
* Activate the [[Resonance Nexus]] in [[Startorch Academy (Region)|Startorch Academy]] during {{Quest|What Burns Beneath Frostlands}} 

===Summary===
* Choose a participating Resonator and dive into simulated combat drills! Under a special tactical view, use your weapons wisely to fend off waves of enemies. As you battle, power up your Resonator with new weapons, weapon upgrades, and boost items. To clear a drill, you must survive every wave of attack.
* Skill Tests come in three types: Training, Op Record, and Challenge. In Training and Op Record stages, the participating Resonators are fixed. In Challenge stages, you can choose any Resonator you like. Clear specific stages to unlock new Resonators, Weapons, and Items.
* Completing Skill Tests will unlock infinite mode, allowing you to participate in the nightmare level, Nightmare: Last Stand.
* By completing event tasks and challenge tasks after meeting specific requirements, you can obtain Simulation Data. Accumulating Simulation Data to the corresponding requirements allows you to claim the "Space and Blake Bloom Medal" and "Space and Blake Bloom" in the event's Limited-Time Rewards. 

==Rules==
* The rewards of this event are divided into Standard Rewards and Limited-Time Rewards. This event will be added to the Permanent Event tab after the Limited-Time Rewards collection period ends.
** After the Limited-Time Rewards collection period ends, Limited-Time Rewards will no longer be available for claiming, but you can still participate in the event to obtain Standard Rewards. Meanwhile, if there are unclaimed Limited-Time Rewards, they will be sent to you via in-game mail if you log in to the game within 30 days after the event ends.
